tasks.description: Identify RDP service details and check for vulnerabilities like BlueKeep.

tasks.title: Password Spraying (CME / NetExec)
tasks.description: Spray credentials against RDP. Note: Use --local-auth when dealing with local accounts instead of domain accounts.

tasks.title: Connect via xfreerdp
tasks.description: Connect to the target with clipboard sharing and drive mounting enabled.

tasks.title: Enable RDP Remotely (If disabled)
tasks.description: If you have a shell (e.g., via Evil-WinRM or SMBExec) but RDP is closed, use these commands to open it and add your user to the RDP group.
commands: netsh advfirewall firewall set rule group="remote desktop" new enable=Yes
